author: Ari Koslow
title: John Brebbia elects free agency
desc: John Brebbia has elected free agency.
impact: Brebbia was designated for assignment by the Rockies earlier in the week. He will explore free agency.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Stuart Fairchild sent outright by Guardians
desc: The Guardians sent OF Stuart Fairchild outright to Triple-A Columbus.
impact: Fairchild was designated for assignment last weekend and passed through waivers unclaimed. He will remain in the Guardians organization.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Joe Ross re-signs with Rangers on minor league deal
desc: The Rangers re-signed RHP Joe Ross to a minor league contract.
impact: Ross returns to the Rangers organization after exploring free agency.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Sam Huff re-signs with Orioles on minor league deal
desc: The Orioles re-signed C Sam Huff to a minor league contract.
impact: Huff returns to Baltimore after exploring free agency.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Chandler Simpson scratched Friday with finger injury
desc: Rays manager Kevin Cash said Chandler Simpson was scratched due to sore right index and middle fingers he jammed sliding into second base in Thursday's game.
impact: It is a precautionary move. Simpson is considered day-to-day.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Victor Robles (forearm) in lineup Friday
desc: Victor Robles is in the Mariners lineup on Friday against the Blue Jays.
impact: Robles is good to go after leaving Thursday's game early after he was hit by a pitch. He is in center field and batting eighth.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Cooper Criswell transferred to 60-day IL
desc: The Mariners transferred Cooper Criswell to the 60-day injured list.
impact: The move opens up a spot on the 40-man roster for Seattle. Criswell is expected to be sidelined into August.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Julio Rodriguez officially lands on concussion IL
desc: The Mariners placed Julio Rodriguez on the concussion injured list.
impact: Rodriguez will miss at least one week. He'll likely be sidelined through the All-Star break.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Max Scherzer throws 49 pitches in rehab start Friday
desc: Max Scherzer threw 49 pitches in a rehab start on Friday.
impact: Scherzer allowed two runs on three hits over three innings with three strikeouts and two walks. It is unclear how many more starts he'll need on his rehab assignment.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Miles Mastrobuoni expected to be called up Friday
desc: Miles Mastrobuoni is in the Mariners clubhouse on Friday.
impact: Mastrobuoni is expected to get called up with Julio Rodriguez getting placed on the concussion IL.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Keegan Akin (elbow) 'looking at all options'
desc: Orioles manager Craig Albernaz said Keegan Akin is "looking at all his options."
impact: Akin was placed on the injured list earlier this week due to elbow discomfort. There should be an update on his status in the coming days when available.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Ryan Helsley (elbow) 'looking at all options'
desc: Orioles manager Craig Albernaz said Ryan Helsley is "looking at all his options."
impact: Helsley was placed on the injured list on Friday. There should be an update on his status within the next few days.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Sal Stewart goes deep in win over Brewers
desc: Sal Stewart went 1-for-4 in a win over the Brewers with a solo home run and one walk.
impact: Stewart continues a torrid stretch at the plate, collecting hits in each of his last eight contests. The rookie remains one of the more explosive bats in the Reds lineup for manager Terry Francona, posting an .813 OPS with 17 home runs, 60 RBI, 46 runs scored, and 11 stolen bases across 86 games.
